rebrew.schema.json is the dispatch contract shared with ai.relumea.app.backend-go,
which mirrors it byte-identically at contracts/dispatch/rebrew.schema.json
(generated there with `go run ./cmd/surface-tracker`). The metadata operations
(rebrew.metadata_describe, rebrew.metadata_diff, rebrew.metadata_carry, the
version 3 capture descriptor, the apply_candidate metadata and
attested_registry_digest fields), rebrew.project_targets, rebrew.vocabulary
(with placeholder_name), rebrew.check_cflags, rebrew.rename_identifier,
the instructions field of the rebrew.verify_function and rebrew.verify_target requests and rebrew.instruction_listing (backend branch
instruction-diff), the rebuilt instructions' symbols and the op and kind enums of
rebrew.instruction_listing (backend branch objdiff2), the renderer of the
rebrew.disassemble and rebrew.disassemble_bytes replies (backend branch listing-key),
the boundaries of the rebrew.library_functions reply (rebrew branch coff-labels),
the discovery_rule of the rebrew.analyse and rebrew.vocabulary replies (rebrew branch
thunk-extent-2),
the top-level documents section (the .relumea/analysis-report.json shape) and
every op's timeout_seconds and interruptible (with the description's sentence
on them) and the rebrew.identify_compiler reply's nullable arch, opt_level,
codegen and packer and boolean packed were extended here first, and
rebrew.coverage_export, rebrew.source_variants,
rebrew.decompme_export, rebrew.source_rename, rebrew.source_split and
rebrew.source_merge were removed here first (no caller; their source work is
rebrew.retained_source_operation); the attribution request member and the required remote_compile response member of
rebrew.verify_function, rebrew.apply_candidate, rebrew.verify_target, rebrew.build and
rebrew.flag_search, and rebrew.flag_search's count_only request member and candidates
response member (compiles on credits) were extended here first; the attribution and
count_only request members and the required remote_compile response member of
rebrew.retained_source_operation were extended here first (backend v0.14.0,
f19474884, has the copy before them), and the required unsettled member of every
remote_compile was extended here first; the enums of the rebrew.retained_source_operation
operation, rebrew.flag_search tier, rebrew.disassemble format and rebrew.reference_flirt
format request members (the sets each op refuses others of) were extended here first; the required billed_undelivered member of every remote_compile was extended here first; the rebrew.report response (out, pages, summary, kinds and the manifest entries' path, size, digest and kinds, whose enum is rebrew.report.SITE_DATA_KINDS) and the enums of the rebrew.decompile and rebrew.decompile_snapshot backend, rebrew.structs decompiler, rebrew.security_scan and rebrew.security_scan_snapshot min_severity and rebrew.retained_source_operation kind request members were extended here first, every enum written by tools/gen_dispatch_schema.py; the required decompilers member of the rebrew.vocabulary response (name, state, reason; its enums written by tools/gen_dispatch_schema.py) was extended here first; the top-level errors (every refusal code and its statuses, from rebrew.ops.PROBLEMS) and the closed responses of rebrew.verify_function, rebrew.verify_target and rebrew.build (from rebrew.ops_replies), written by tools/gen_dispatch_schema.py, were extended here first; the rebrew.verify_target and rebrew.build responses without binary and out (written by tools/gen_dispatch_schema.py) were changed here first; the declared responses write a nullable member as oneOf [{type}, {"type": "null"}] and omit an empty required, as the backend renders them; the nested members of the rebrew.verify_function, rebrew.verify_target and rebrew.build responses (from rebrew.ops_replies) were declared here first; the rebrew.identify_library and rebrew.coverage_report responses (from rebrew.ops_replies) were declared here first; the remaining 15 responses (from rebrew.ops_replies), the "format": "workspace-path" of each workspace path member (from rebrew.ops_replies.WORKSPACE_PATHS), and each op's errors (rebrew.ops.DISPATCH_PROBLEMS and OP_PROBLEMS) were declared here first; the rebrew.release op (request {}, response release and schema_sha256) was added here first; the nested members of the rebrew.analyze, pe_info, flag_search, data_list, verify_function, verify_target and build responses, and every map typed by its values, were declared here first; verify_target's data, text and whole_binary were removed here first; the rebrew.report and rebrew.security_scan_snapshot responses (from rebrew.ops_replies) were declared here first; the rebrew.apply_candidate response (from rebrew.ops_replies, its result a verify_function response) was declared here first; the no-decompilation refusal (422) of rebrew.decompile, rebrew.decompile_snapshot and rebrew.structs was added here first; the rebrew.apply_candidate result without remote_compile was declared here first; a compile record's execution (recompile's ExecutionProvenance) and the rebrew.retained_source_operation result (a oneOf of one shape per operation) were declared here first; invalid-project-config was removed from the rebrew.rename_identifier and rebrew.apply_candidate errors here first; skipped_records on the ops in rebrew.ops.SKIPPED_RECORD_OPS (with import-project and import_archive added, and verify_target dropped) was declared here first; rebrew.import_archive is the entry the backend generates
from its rebrew.ImportArchive definition (branch fix-yc-reversed, commit "define
rebrew.import_archive"); the rest is the copy of backend commit
80314a46a1ae26d9ef3d56d90e1d454c561f5928.
SHA-256: 0a0ae03ccbef17e0fca0babab877d6ee7dd466ba96c112f6b9a4891a320cd264.
tests/test_ops.py validates every op request and reply against it, the
analysis report rebrew.analyse captures against documents, and every op's
timeout_seconds and interruptible against rebrew.ops.OPS.
